messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Candidate | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear ION Talent Team,

I am approaching ION because of your focus on senior and international talent across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with 12+ years across mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

My executive scope spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, social performance, strategic stakeholders, compliance coordination and executive communications. I work across ministries, regulators, communities, technical teams and senior leadership, translating external requirements into clear ownership and execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates in Saudi Arabia across ESG, external affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, responsible business, country leadership and transformation. I am internationally mobile, available after a 30-day notice period, and require employer-supported work authorization.

Please consider my attached three-page executive CV for current and upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
